messages:
Priya Rao: Quick announcement: we're planning a short-form benchmark highlight + PR push Thursday 09:30 PT. Need a media-ready quote and a one-paragraph FAQ for reporters.
Marcus Hill: Noted. I'll lineup two spokespeople: Nina for tech details, Jamie for customer angle.
Nina Ortiz: I can draft a 2-sentence technical quote. Prefer we avoid raw numbers in the quote.
Jamie Park: I'll draft the customer-focused line and a separate note for customer comms. Who owns partner outreach?
Priya Rao: Marcus will coordinate partner vendors. Please avoid sending preview assets until embargo lift.
press-bot: Embargo reminder set: 2026-03-26T16:30:00Z. Auto-monitor enabled.
Marcus Hill: Partners told. Also, legal asked to remove one sentence about "industry-leading"; replaced with "notable reductions in latency and cost" per counsel.
Nina Ortiz: Drafted tech quote: "Our internal benchmarks show measurable latency and cost improvements on real-world LLM workloads; full methodology will be published with the report."
Jamie Park: Drafted customer quote: "Early adopters are seeing meaningful performance gains; we'll share case studies after publish."
Priya Rao: Good. Jamie — please prep a short email for customers who received preview assets reminding them of the embargo and next steps.
Jamie Park: Email drafted and posted: https://drive.redwood/bench/customer-email-v1 (cc Marcus).
Marcus Hill: Social plan: initial tweets + LinkedIn at publish, then amplify with engineer thread 1 hour later. Scheduling now.
Priya Rao: Ops note: use #press-watch during the window. If a pickup occurs before embargo, escalate to @exec-comm.
press-bot: Scheduled social posts paused until final sign-off.
Nina Ortiz: One last ask — add the methodology FAQ to the blog and include a contact line for dataset inquiries.
Priya Rao: Will do. Final check at 08:45 PT Thursday in this thread. If no objections by EOD tomorrow, we proceed. :white_check_mark:
